title: Watch Dogs 2 bar for the new centre areas: layers by data and recurring look critics
desc: Seed for PLAN_PHASE P7 (harness/design/FIDELITY_BAR.md, OWNER_EYE.md, decisions.md 2026-11-14). Every new area is built to the bar the pilot reached in P2, through the same layers tuned by data (grade, soft wear and detail normals, road surfaces, shop interiors, street life, vehicles, trees and ground cover, motion, night emissives), never by hand-building what a layer does. The planner splits this into: one look critic task (verifier on Sonnet, priority 1) after every 3 to 4 look tasks of the phase, plus a side by side sheet per new area beside dated current photos with the WD2 bar question answered per shot. Lutyens, Khan Market, Lodhi, Nizamuddin, the Ridge and the Yamuna floodplain each have their own look (foliage-heavy areas lean on rows 11 and 12 of the bar).
accept: The P7 plan has a look critic task after every 3 to 4 look tasks, each with the acceptance of P2-051
Each new area's side by side sheet is read beside dated current photos and passes the WD2 bar question and every OWNER_EYE.md line
Perf on the new areas' camera paths stays inside the signed system lines (quiet machine, load quoted)

title: Watch Dogs 2 bar for the far south and the corridors: layers by data, speed, and look critics
desc: Seed for PLAN_PHASE P8 (FIDELITY_BAR.md, OWNER_EYE.md). Qutub, Vasant Kunj, the airport, Gurugram and the corridors get the bar through the same data-driven layers.
